stages.name: v1.0 baseline
stages.reason: Rebuilding the first index would replace the 18,600 document points. This pass only ran queries. The documents collection was not rebuilt.

stages.name: dense
stages.reason: Dense-only query. Top 5 checked for the gold section.

stages.name: +headers
stages.reason: Headers are already in the live chunks. A header-free index would be a second collection. This pass only ran queries. The documents collection was not rebuilt.

stages.name: +BM25 hybrid
stages.reason: Dense plus BM25 with RRF and the tax-year filter. Same gold-section check.

stages.name: +rerank
stages.reason: The cross-encoder was not loaded, so a cold download would not start.

stages.name: +parent expansion
stages.reason: Same hybrid hits, plus the parent section text already stored in Postgres.

stages.name: +verification
stages.reason: Verification calls an outside model. This pass did not spend those calls.

stages.name: +web fallback
stages.reason: Share of the sample with any web_pages hit. Coverage, not ordinance recall.
